title: [EXA-7] Relay manifest key ids are invalid `did:key` DID URLs, and the manifest signer is ambiguou
description: Review finding EXA-7: Relay manifest key ids are invalid `did:key` DID URLs, and the manifest signer is ambiguous (lens EXA). Location: spec/10-relays.md:72, 102. Fix: As the reviewer proposed. The preferred form is to switch the example to `did:web:relay.example.com` with `#key-1`, because 10:110 says public relays SHOULD use `did:web`. That also resolves EXA-19's 10:55 point. Change 10:102 to "signed per §13.1.1 by `relayDID`". Full text: notes/review/EXA-verified.md and notes/review/EXA.md.
